standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the difference of two 2-morphisms to be lifted to an automorphism of the source point.

core_obligations: Reformulate as a uniqueness statement: the proof has to show that for a given pair there is at most one object of the source mapping to it (proof lines 10145-10146)
Describe the objects: using the construction of 2-fibre products, an object is given by a triple of two objects and a 2-morphism between the two ways around the square (proof lines 10147-10150)

Compare two triples: the two 2-morphisms differ by a value of the automorphism group of the image point, which by the hypothesis lifts to an automorphism of the source point, and the pair consisting of that lift and the identity gives the required isomorphism of triples (proof lines 10150-10156)
proof_roadmap: 把结论写成唯一性：给定 (y', x) 至多一个 x'。由 2-纤维积的构造，x' 由三元组 (x, y', α) 给出，其中 α: g∘y' → f∘x 是 2-态射。
设另一个三元组 (x, y', β)，则 α 与 β 相差 G_{f(x)} 的一个 k-值点 ε；由假设 G_x → G_{f(x)} 是同构，ε 可提升为 G_x 的 k-值点 γ，于是 (γ, id) 给出三元组之间的同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a cartesian diagram of algebraic stacks in which the vertical morphism induces isomorphisms between automorphism groups at points, the induced comparison map on the isomorphism classes of points over a field is injective (author lemma at source lines 10123-10142, label lemma-stabilizer-preserving-points-cartesian). The proof (source lines 10144-10157) rewrites the assertion as the uniqueness of an object filling a given pair, describes such objects as triples using the construction of 2-fibre products, and lifts the difference of the two 2-morphisms along the assumed isomorphism of automorphism groups (proof lines 10145-10156). The lifting of the difference is the content. H2.
